scenario: Two-page services proposal with deliverables, exclusions, pricing and acceptance
generation: Deterministic authored fixtures; no client or external personal data

blocks.text:
Prepared for Alder Studio     •     Prepared by Northstar Design
Issued 18 June 2027     •     Proposal valid through 2 July 2027

blocks.label: THE OUTCOME
blocks.text: A clearer first-week experience: one welcome journey, one account checklist and fewer handoffs between sales and customer success.
New customers receive setup instructions in three separate emails. The proposed work consolidates those steps, clarifies ownership and gives the service team a reusable launch checklist.

rows: Five staff interviews; journey map; agreed problem statement
Welcome flow; six screen designs; email copy outline
Annotated prototype; component notes; two training sessions

items: One 30-minute review each Tuesday, with a named client decision-maker.
Two consolidated feedback rounds on the prototype.
Shared decision log and weekly written delivery update.

blocks.text: Production code, system migration, translation and new brand identity work are excluded. Any added scope requires a written change agreement.
40% at kickoff ($4,800), 40% at prototype review ($4,800), and 20% at handover ($2,400). This illustrative price excludes applicable taxes and third-party expenses.

items: Provide current onboarding material and access to five interview participants.
Return consolidated feedback within two working days.
Confirm content accuracy and nominate an approver before kickoff.

blocks.text: Acceptance covers six annotated screens, the welcome email outline, a working prototype and two team sessions. The lead records acceptance or specific scope-related corrections.

Alder Studio sponsor Priya Shah and Northstar lead Maya Chen review scope on 25 June. Proposed kickoff: 5 July. Acceptance is a recorded review of the agreed deliverables, not an automatic consequence of payment.

capabilities: Scope narrative, pricing visualization and acceptance criteria
